title: Tonight: last RPV concert, Sunday book festival
intro: Tonight is the last Rancho Palos Verdes summer concert — Pulp Vixen, 4–6 at the Ken Dyda Civic Center, free, with inflatables and crafts. Sunday, if you want a bigger outing, is the LA Kids Book Festival in West Hollywood (free; register). Cards below. We left parking, food, and prices blank unless we could confirm them.

picks.name: RPV Summer Concerts in the Park: Pulp Vixen
picks.address: Ken Dyda Civic Center, 30940 Hawthorne Blvd
picks.cost_math: 2 adults + 2 kids: free entry, parking unknown.
picks.food: Food trucks on site; picnic blankets welcome.
picks.why: Last concert of the series, with inflatables, crafts, and music-themed giveaways for kids.

picks.name: Redondo Pier Summer of Music: CC Stugino
picks.address: Fisherman’s Wharf, west end of the Pier
picks.cost_math: 2 adults + 2 kids: free entry, parking unknown. Weather permitting.
picks.why: Free blues-rock on the pier, open to the public.

picks.name: Griffith Observatory public star party
picks.cost_math: 2 adults + 2 kids: free entry (building, grounds, and public telescopes). Parking is paid at the Observatory lot and nearby street; the official getting-here page does not list the rate. Limited.
picks.parking: Paid lot and street near the Observatory, limited. Free parking around the Greek Theatre if you can walk up to a mile uphill (not after 1 p.m. on concert evenings).
picks.why: Look through volunteer telescopes at the Sun, Moon, and planets — a family outing worth the drive.

picks.name: LA Kids Book Festival
picks.address: West Hollywood Park, 647 N San Vicente Blvd
picks.cost_math: 2 adults + 2 kids: free entry (register). Parking if you use Lot A all day: $1/15 min, $12 daily max (first hour free; extra hour with park/rec validation).
picks.parking: Lot A garage at West Hollywood Park (paid, $12 daily max). Street meters $1–$2/hour.
picks.food: Food trucks, drinks, and snacks on site.
picks.why: Authors, performances, and a closing foam party — free if you register.

picks.name: Downtown Torrance Antique Street Faire
picks.cost_math: 2 adults + 2 kids: free admission, parking unknown. Optional antique appraisal is $3 per item.
picks.food: Buy there — restaurants in downtown Torrance.
picks.why: Vintage stalls, live music, and a noon dance performance, a few blocks from home.

picks.name: Family Science Sunday at Marine Mammal Care Center
picks.when: Sunday, August 23 — sessions at 11 a.m., 1 p.m., 2 p.m., and 3 p.m.
picks.cost_math: 2 adults + 2 kids: $1 nonrefundable booking fee each ($4) if all four join. Admission otherwise free. Fee waived with code MMCARE if needed. Parking free on site.
picks.parking: Free lot in front of the hospital.
picks.why: A one-hour ocean science session plus patient viewing and the exhibit hall.
picks.age_gate: Ages 8 and up; adults must accompany children 13 and under.
picks.price_text: $1 booking fee per person; admission otherwise free

picks.name: Let’s Get Organized
picks.cost_math: 2 adults + 2 kids: free program, parking unknown.
picks.why: Design a desk organizer before school starts.
picks.age_gate: Ages 5–12 with a parent or caregiver.

picks.name: Smarty Pants Storytime
picks.cost_math: 2 adults + 2 kids: free program, parking unknown. Register everyone in your party.
picks.why: Books, songs, and movement for school readiness — a short Friday stop.
picks.age_gate: Ages 2–5 with a parent or caregiver.

picks.name: Friday Fun at Madrona Marsh
picks.address: Madrona Marsh Nature Center, 3201 Plaza Del Amo
picks.cost_math: 2 adults + 2 kids: free program, parking unknown. Call Tuesday at 10 a.m. to register; first 20 people.
picks.why: Story time, science, art, and a nature tour for preschoolers.
picks.age_gate: Ages 3–6 with a parent or guardian.

picks.name: Torrance Summer Nights: Coldplay USA
picks.cost_math: 2 adults + 2 kids: free entry, parking unknown.
picks.why: A free tribute set on the Wilson Park lawn. Bring a blanket or chair.

picks.name: Korean Friendship Bell
picks.cost_math: 2 adults + 2 kids: free to visit, parking unknown.
picks.why: Pair a Labor Day Saturday at the bell with ArtLab down the hill, then Petty Theft in Torrance.

picks.name: ArtLab: Science & Art Workshops
picks.address: Marine Mammal Care Center, 3601 S. Gaffey St
picks.cost_math: 2 adults + 2 kids: free workshop (register on Eventbrite about two weeks prior). Parking free at MMCC.
picks.parking: Free lot in front of the hospital.
picks.why: A science lesson, a tour of patients, and an art project — supplies included.
picks.age_gate: All ages; children must be with an adult.

picks.name: Torrance Summer Nights: Petty Theft
picks.cost_math: 2 adults + 2 kids: free entry, parking unknown.
picks.why: Tom Petty tribute on the Wilson Park lawn after a San Pedro afternoon.

picks.name: Cabrillo Marine Aquarium
picks.cost_math: 2 adults + 2 kids: free entry. Suggested donation $10/adult, $5/child ($30 if you give). Parking $3/hr, $9 daily max (card only) — $9 required if you drive and stay.
picks.parking: Cabrillo Beach paid lot, $3/hr with a $9 daily max.
picks.food: Picnic areas in Cabrillo Coastal Park next to the aquarium.
picks.why: Southern California marine life, free to walk in, a few minutes from the harbor.

picks.name: Marine Mammal Care Center public visitation
picks.cost_math: 2 adults + 2 kids: free entry. Parking free on site. Reserve ahead; walk-ins are limited.
picks.parking: Free lot in front of the hospital.
picks.why: See seal and sea lion patients and the exhibit hall without a program fee.
